'''The Wind Blows Over the Wall''' is a [[sword form]]. Other than the name, nothing is known about it. [[Rand al'Thor]] used this form to cut off a [[Gray Man]]'s hand before driving a ''[[saidin]]''-wrought sword through his opponent's heart.{{ref/book|4|9}}
